data.title: BitMine nears 5% of Ethereum supply after $19M ... | Pluang
data.description: BitMine Immersion Technologies has purchased an additional $19 million worth of Ethereum, bringing its total holdings to about 5.78 million ETH, or roughly 4.8% of all Ethereum in existence. The company has been steadily buying ETH weekly since June 2025 and staking over 4.9 million ETH to generate yield. Backed by major investors like ARK Invest and Galaxy Digital, BitMine aims to reach 5% of the total ETH supply soon, solidifying its position as the largest corporate Ethereum holder worldwide.
